name: Elina Svitolina
intro: Elina Svitolina is a tennis star from Ukraine. She is the No. 9 seed. A seed is a ranking badge for top players. Her superpower is chasing down every ball.
story: Elina started tennis at age five. Her big brother played first. She wanted to play too. She has been a top player for more than ten years. This January she reached the final four in Australia. She won two matches in New York this year. Next time, watch her chase every ball!

funFacts.text: She is a mom! Her daughter Skaï was born in October 2022.
Her dad was a wrestler. Her mom was a rower. Sporty family!
She was named after a famous movie actress, Elina Bystritskaya.
Her big brother Yulian played tennis first. She wanted to play too.
She loves soccer and cheers for Chelsea, a team in London.
She won a bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics.
She has won 20 tour titles. That is a lot of trophies!
Her birthday is September 12. She turns 32 next week!

watchFor: Watch her run down balls that look impossible to reach.
